answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each identity rents one rowing station on a voyage leaving at dawn, locking a 70-credit bond and a 45 fee. At zenith the holder must show a key-signed log; a missed or shared slot burns the bond. The voyage manifest lists every slot; rented rowers fail since one rower cannot staff two stations. The kth slot costs 45+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 in fees and lock 70,000, while an honest sailor pays 45 once.
